title: Todd Monken gets upset, ends physical Browns practice early

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Todd Monken gets upset, ends physical Browns practice early
sources.description: Browns head coach Todd Monken found himself "emotionally hijacked" during a practice early in training camp and he was hot under the collar again on Tuesday.
